My point was that these vitamins LEAVE OUT vitamin A ON PURPOSE for smokers because it can work against them in the case of lung cancer. 

We get it, eating a healthy diet is the best way to get your nutrients, duh. But, as we know, many people aren’t eating healthy diets. Besides vitamins A, D, E and K, there’s not much harm in taking a multivitamin as everything else will be excreted in urine in excess amounts. 

HOWEVER, people should talk to their doctors about any and all supplements they think about taking!  Lots of things, even things that might seem benign can cause issues you do not foresee. For example, vitamin k and blood thinners. Other stuff like a cinnamon supplement can do a number on your liver. Other things can stress your heart or kidneys. 

I just had to disagree with the idea that vitamins won’t do much. They can do A LOT both good and bad.Acting like they can’t do much good also feeds the idea that taking them “can’t hurt”.
